facts.fact: The PIB Fact Check Unit checks information relating to the Government of India, its Ministries and Departments
facts.quote: The PIB Fact Check unit only takes up complaints related to the Government of India, its Ministries, Departments, Public Sector entities etc.

facts.fact: Messages can be sent for fact-checking to the PIB Fact Check WhatsApp hotline +91 8799711259
facts.quote: Where can users submit their Fact Check complaints? WhatsApp Hotline - +91 8799711259

facts.fact: Complaints can also be submitted on the portal factcheck.pib.gov.in or by email to factcheck@pib.gov.in
facts.quote: Email ID - factcheck[at]pib[dot]gov[dot]in Website Portal - https://factcheck.pib.gov.in/

behaviour: Points the user to PIB Fact Check (Press Information Bureau) to verify the viral message, giving its official submission channels and citing pib.gov.in.
fail_if: It vouches for or debunks the message itself without an official source, sends the user to a non-official fact-checker only, or gives a WhatsApp number, email or portal other than PIB's.
summary: PIB Fact Check Unit FAQ: Government of India matters; WhatsApp +91 8799711259, factcheck.pib.gov.in, factcheck@pib.gov.in.
